implementation: One local atlas, shared by all 20 games. Per-subject source rectangles prevent adjacent-cell bleed and maintain aspect ratio. Prototype is a design reference; rules and text are real code, never baked into a screen image.

assets.prompt: Generate an original transparent sprite atlas with exactly 4 columns and 3 rows. Row 1: orange cat, brown dog, blue bird, pink fish. Row 2: cream rabbit, green frog, red apple, yellow banana. Row 3: teal toy car, blue sailboat, pink flower with green stem, golden five-point star. Bright flat preschool animation, thick rounded brown outlines, simple expressive faces, no text, no frame, generous transparent padding, landscape 4:3. Original designs; no copyrighted characters.
